## Legal-content checklist

Complete this section when the change affects legal information.

- [ ] Official source URL is included.
- [ ] Exact article, section, subsection or schedule is identified.
- [ ] Legal status and effective/version date were checked.
- [ ] Last-verification date is recorded.
- [ ] Important exceptions are preserved.
- [ ] The change has received or requires domain review.
- [ ] No news report, blog or social-media post is used as sole legal authority.
